message.content: Service is up (PID 968, listening on 127.0.0.1:8765). Now, in a **separate** call, let me confirm it survived and curl the endpoint for real.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd "$(pwd)"
echo "=== process check (new shell invocation) ==="
ps -o pid,ppid,pgid,sess,etime,cmd -p "$(cat service.pid)" || { echo "PROCESS GONE"; exit 9; }
echo "=== curl (real request) ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/curl_body.$$ -w 'http_code=%{http_code}\ncontent_type=%{content_type}\nsize_download=%{size_download}\ntime_total=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health
echo "=== response body (cat) ==="
cat /tmp/curl_body.$$
echo ""
echo "=== write real body to service.txt ==="
cp /tmp/curl_body.$$ service.txt
rm -f /tmp/curl_body.$$
echo "--- service.txt bytes ---"
wc -c service.txt
od -c service.txt"}
